desc:
Fast-paced third-person PvP where aim, movement, and rank decide everything.

⚔️ Battle Modes
▪ 1v1 Duels
▪ 2v2 – 5v5 Team Fights
▪ Clan Wars

🏆 Rank System
▪ Win matches to gain rank
▪ Climb from low rank to the top
▪ Prove your skill in every fight
▪ Dominate the arena and show your rank

PC
• WASD – Move
• Mouse – Aim
• Left Click – Shoot
• Right Click – Aim / Zoom
• Space – Roll / Dodge
• R – Reload
• V – Open Tool
• B – Open Bag
• N – Open Skin

🎯 Features
• Smooth third-person gunplay
• Competitive maps made for fast fights
• Real-time clan rankings

🏆 Progression
Win matches. Rank up. Dominate your rivals.

💬 Join a clan or build your own crew.
👍 Like & Favorite to support future updates!
